_meta.title: IPC (1860) to BNS (2023) concordance - curated subset
_meta.note: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 replaced the IPC for offences committed on or after 1 July 2024. Offences committed on or before 30 June 2024 are still charged under the IPC. There is no official machine-readable one-to-one concordance; several IPC offences were merged, split or re-defined. Every mapping below is a working reference for a police officer / advocate to VERIFY against the bare act before use.
_meta.coverage: high-frequency sections only; unmapped IPC sections are surfaced with mapping_status=unmapped
